Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a.name: Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a Side Door
Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a.trigger: Voyage grants it from the story start (startingQuests); never seeded by a prompt. Record `quest-start` at turn 1 when Voyage shows it. Finishing event, Voyage's: the player accepts a first Guild work contract in Aureliath (planned Day 2 to 3).
Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a.success: Voyage's: the player accepts a first Guild work contract.
Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a.seed_line: (none: Voyage grants this quest from the story start; do not seed it)
Summoned and Discarded: Severance and a.notes: Seed info only. Director steers where contracts are (the Guild Quarter queue and counter; one ordinary posting; one slip from the private board), never which one is taken. The 25 gold is already in the starting inventory: never grant more. Registration and rank are Voyage's. Voyage owns progress.

Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.name: Summoned and Discarded: The Power They Couldn't Measure
Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.trigger: Voyage offers it after the first contract is accepted. Director plants conditions only: a dimensional break at a rift in the Forgotten Aqueducts around Day 20 (the first shared jobs lead there), then Serika's verification team (about Day 22). The player's sheet decides the power; the quest text assumes dimensional-boundary manipulation: treat that loosely and never contradict the sheet.
Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.success: Voyage's: the player demonstrates the unmeasured capability, privately or publicly.
Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.fail: None: declined or abandoned stays closed unless revisited.
Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.seed_line: (none: Voyage offers this quest from the story; plant the rift break and the observers, never name the quest)
Summoned and Discarded: The Power They C.notes: Seed info only. Public exposure, Serika's response and a change to the classification system are not completion requirements. Rin stands beside the player first if the power surfaces publicly. Voyage owns progress.

Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.name: Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vindication
Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.trigger: Voyage offers it only after chapter 2 is completed. Director plants conditions only: Suzuha reaches out privately (Guild reports; her market hour); the scene is the throne room, about Day 97, answered by the whole party.
Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.success: Voyage's: the player gives the kingdom their final answer about the future relationship.
Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.fail: None: the game continues as a sandbox.
Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.seed_line: (none: Voyage offers this quest from the story; plant Suzuha's private approach, never name the quest)
Summoned and Discarded: The Misfire's Vi.notes: Seed info only. The offer: become the first Reborn-classified adventurer; the catch is visibility. Serika must accept her system is incomplete or double down. Suzuha is a palace contact, not a party member, unless both agree. Voyage owns progress.

The Quiet Posting.name: The Quiet Posting
The Quiet Posting.trigger: Day 4 to 5, after Mizuho arrives (Studio edit): she notices the player fits the profile of those who take jobs from a private posting board that bypasses her counter.

objectives.text: Take or refuse the board's first offer.
Learn who the board has recruited.
Decide what to do about the board.

The Quiet Posting.success: The party learns who runs the board and what happened to those who took its jobs.
The Quiet Posting.fail: The board keeps recruiting; people stay missing; nothing ends.
The Quiet Posting.seed_line: Start quest "The Quiet Posting" (giver: Mizuho Kaimaku): find out who posts private jobs behind the Guild counter.

log.evidence: Mizuho: 'If you take it, come back to this counter afterward and tell me whom you meet. Not for the Guild. For me.'

The Quiet Posting.notes: Voyage owns progress. The through-line of all four acts.

Door of Her Own.name: Door of Her Own
Door of Her Own.trigger: Unlocks after real closeness with Yumi (a shared secret, her curse cracking around the player, time at the cart).

objectives.text: See what the curse does to her.
Get ahead of the resurfaced glyph before House Souen's records do.

Door of Her Own.success: A door with her own key: her mother found and the curse lifted, or a choice made.
Door of Her Own.seed_line: Start quest "Door of Her Own" (giver: Yumi Aokiba): help find the person Yumi cannot name, and the old glyph that resurfaced.

The Unperformed Song.name: The Unperformed Song
The Unperformed Song.trigger: Unlocks after Ren's Earth song is recognized (about Day 27) or he trusts the player with the half-finished piece.

objectives.text: Deal with the masked attendant's requests.
Play it where it can be heard.

The Unperformed Song.success: The song is finished, and heard, by someone he trusted.
The Unperformed Song.fail: The song stays a rehearsal; the masks multiply.
The Unperformed Song.seed_line: Start quest "The Unperformed Song" (giver: Ren Tsukishiro): hear the piece Ren has never played in public.

A Seat Saved.name: A Seat Saved
A Seat Saved.trigger: Unlocks after Day 34, once the palace has asked Toma to explain, or after real closeness with him.

objectives.text: Learn what he has been doing.
Stand with him at the palace.

A Seat Saved.success: Toma answers aloud which side he is on.
A Seat Saved.fail: He keeps paying the interest in silence.
A Seat Saved.seed_line: Start quest "A Seat Saved" (giver: Toma Kirisawa): stand beside Toma when the Court asks him to explain.

First Light, No Witnesses.name: First Light, No Witnesses
First Light, No Witnesses.trigger: Unlocks when the player digs up her A-Rank record and she invites them to spar at first light (about Day 48).
First Light, No Witnesses.success: A partner against the board and the fiercest guardian angel in the Guild.
First Light, No Witnesses.fail: She goes after the board alone.
First Light, No Witnesses.seed_line: Start quest "First Light, No Witnesses" (giver: Mizuho Kaimaku): spar with Mizuho at first light.
